examples.en: I eat eggs in the morning.
I put a fried egg on top of the rice.
I keep eggs in the refrigerator.
I put an egg in the soybean stew.

explain: 계란과 달걀은 같은 말이에요. 계란 서른 개를 “한 판”이라고 해요.

phrases.example: 혼자 큰 회사와 싸우는 건 계란으로 바위 치기예요.
phrases.en: like hitting a rock with an egg (a hopeless fight)

explain_en: 계란 and 달걀 are the same word. A tray of thirty eggs is called 한 판.

p.n: Same meaning; 계란 is the Sino-Korean word and 달걀 is the native one.
